scenarios.name: Global Stagflation Persistence
scenarios.description: Persistent supply-side inflation driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions (Middle East conflicts, Ukraine war continuation), leading to prolonged high energy and food prices. Central banks maintain restrictive monetary policy despite slowing growth, creating classic stagflation conditions.

impacts.explanation: Energy and commodity price shocks increase consumer prices
Restrictive monetary policy combined with elevated input costs reduces economic growth
Central bank raises rates to combat persistent inflation
Higher production costs and reduced demand lower output

scenarios.reasoning: Given current inflation at 21.97% above baseline and ongoing geopolitical conflicts, stagflation remains the most probable outcome per outside view analysis
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work
Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Soft Landing Success
scenarios.description: Federal Reserve successfully navigates economic normalization through calibrated rate cuts as inflation moderates. Labor market gradually cools to sustainable levels while consumer spending remains resilient. Supply chain disruptions resolve faster than expected.

impacts.explanation: Base effects and moderating services inflation reduce headline CPI
Improved confidence and lower financing costs boost investment
Gradual labor market cooling as tightness eases
Rate cuts signal policy pivot as inflation approaches target

scenarios.reasoning: Historical precedent shows central banks can achieve soft landings with careful calibration; current data suggests moderate trajectory is plausible
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems
Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Aggressive Trade War Escalation
scenarios.description: Major trading partners escalate tit-for-tat tariffs following US semiconductor export controls expansion. China responds with broad technology sector restrictions while EU implements carbon border adjustments more aggressively than anticipated.

impacts.explanation: Tariffs increase import prices across manufacturing supply chains
Export reduction and higher input costs contract economic activity
Reduced exports and tariff retaliation worsen trade deficit
Supply chain disruptions reduce manufacturing output

scenarios.reasoning: Current protectionist momentum and technology decoupling trends suggest moderate probability of escalation with significant economic consequences
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work
Try, fail, analyze, adjust, try again

scenarios.name: Financial Crisis Trigger
scenarios.description: Commercial real estate defaults surge following office vacancy rate increases from permanent remote work adoption. Regional banking system experiences liquidity stress leading to credit crunch. Corporate bond defaults spike particularly in rate-sensitive sectors.

impacts.explanation: Credit tightening and wealth effects from asset price declines
Economic contraction leads to significant job losses
Emergency rate cuts to provide liquidity and stabilize markets
Credit crunch severely impacts residential investment

scenarios.reasoning: Structural vulnerabilities in CRE market and banking system represent tail risk that materializes with lower probability but severe impact
tetlockCommandments: Triage - Focus on questions where careful thinking pays off
Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: AI Productivity Boom
scenarios.description: Breakthrough AI deployment accelerates productivity growth beyond expectations. Businesses rapidly adopt generative AI tools leading to productivity gains in services sector. Technology investment surge funds expansion across multiple industries.

impacts.explanation: Significant productivity improvements drive economic expansion
Productivity gains reduce unit labor costs and service prices
New technology sector jobs offset automation displacement
Increased consumer purchasing power drives retail growth

scenarios.reasoning: While AI potential exists, realization of broad-based productivity gains within 12 months represents upside risk with limited probability but transformative effects

scenarios.name: Climate Policy Shock
scenarios.description: Major climate legislation implementation causes unexpected energy price volatility. Stricter carbon pricing combined with extreme weather events (hurricane season impacts) disrupts energy infrastructure. Green investment boom begins earlier than scheduled.

impacts.explanation: Energy price volatility increases headline inflation
Green investment stimulus boosts manufacturing activity
Energy import dependency increases with transition disruption
Infrastructure rebuilding creates construction demand

scenarios.reasoning: Climate risks and policy responses remain highly uncertain but represent growing concern based on recent extreme weather patterns and legislative developments

scenarios.name: Geopolitical De-escalation
scenarios.description: Major diplomatic breakthrough reduces tensions in key conflict zones. Ceasefire agreements in Middle East and progress toward Ukraine settlement remove supply shock risks. International cooperation on trade and technology standards resumes.

impacts.explanation: Energy and commodity price stabilization reduces input costs
Reduced uncertainty boosts business investment and consumer confidence
Improved outlook allows for less restrictive monetary policy
Normalization of energy exports improves balance

scenarios.reasoning: While historically low probability given current tensions, sudden diplomatic breakthroughs have occurred before and would dramatically alter economic trajectory

methodology: Applied Tetlock's superforecasting methodology including outside view analysis using historical base rates, granular decomposition of complex economic phenomena, continuous probability updating based on indicator trends, and cognitive debiasing to avoid overconfidence. Scenarios weighted by assessed probabilities reflecting clash of causal forces.
